name: get_stock_item_count

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetStockItemCount replaces the top item ID with the unequipped-stock byte at D_003010F8 + 0x499 + item_id

notes: Unlike command 253 get_total_item_count, this handler does not inspect character item slots. The adjacent command 258 handler updates the same byte by a signed amount and clamps it to 0 through 99. All 32 JP calls pass literal item IDs 4, 6, 154, or 254, immediately store the result in local 6, and compare it with 99; each also stores the same item ID in variable 4356 immediately beforehand.
